name: Microsoft Teams
author: Jan Renz
description: Teams chats and channels in the Omarchy bar and in a window of their own. Needs python3 (standard library only) and an Azure app registration of yours - see the README. Talks to Microsoft Graph and nothing else.

barWidget.description: Unread chats in the bar; the conversations open in their own window.

schema.label: Account name
schema.description: A short name for this sign-in, e.g. work. Letters, numbers, dot, dash and underscore.

schema.label: Azure client id
schema.description: Required. Your own app registration's Application (client) ID. Teams cannot reuse a registration made for mail: a registration declares which permissions it may request. See the plugin README for the exact setup.

schema.label: Authority
schema.description: common, organizations, or your tenant id. Leave empty for common.

schema.label: Include teams and channels
schema.description: Off signs in for chats alone. On also asks for channel access, which normally needs an administrator to consent for the whole tenant - if that consent is refused the sign-in fails, and chats-only will still work.

schema.label: Spacing
schema.description: How much room the window gives things. Scales the theme's own spacing, so it follows your font size rather than fighting it.

schema.label: Bar icon
schema.description: Nerd Font glyph shown in the bar. Ignored when a label is set.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: Short text shown instead of the icon, e.g. TEAMS.

schema.label: Highlight the bar icon when a chat is unread
